info.title: Status Pulse API
info.description: Complete weeks 1–6 API contract for the Status Pulse dashboard and public status pages. Opaque bearer sessions protect project routes; roles are scoped to each project. Public routes explicitly exclude endpoint URLs, credentials, members, private notes, and configuration. Email/verification/payments are simulations only. No hosted deployment is asserted by this contract.

get.description: Verifies API/database readiness, not worker progress.

post.description: Normalizes email, hashes password, creates account/session/audit transactionally. Does not grant existing project access. Unexpected fields are rejected.
Deletes the current session. Subsequent reuse receives 401.
Any authenticated account; inserts project and owner membership together.

patch.description: Owner only. Supply latest project.version; stale version returns 409.

delete.description: Owner only. Archives project and services, disables work/public exposure, preserves history.

get.description: Owner only; safe account identity projection.

post.description: Owner only. Creates a 24-hour token invitation for responder/viewer and expires earlier unaccepted invitations to the same email. No email is sent. Raw simulator token is visible only to authenticated owner.
Authenticated account must match normalized invited email. Grants membership once, records acceptance/audit. Invalid/expired/reused invitation fails.

patch.description: Owner only; owner transfers are unsupported.

delete.description: Owner only. Owner cannot be removed.

post.description: Owner only. Applies plan limits, URL/SSRF syntax policy and cross-field validation; stores configuration version and audit transactionally. DNS/actual connection safety is checked again at execution.

get.description: Owner, responder, viewer. Private configuration must never be forwarded to anonymous users.

patch.description: Owner only. Put current service.configVersion in body.version. Resets observation counters and stores a new version; stale writers get 409. Unspecified fields are preserved.

delete.description: Owner only. Disables work and public exposure without removing historical records.

get.description: Any project member. One authoritative result per job; applied distinguishes results used by current status.

post.description: Owner/responder only, enabled service required. Returns a queued job; worker executes later. Send no request body.

get.description: Project member only; internal reason is not a public field.

put.description: Owner/responder. Expiry must be future and within 24 hours. Preserves calculated status, records actor/reason/history/audit. Disabled services remain unknown.

delete.description: Owner/responder. Restores calculated effective state, including unknown if stale.

post.description: Owner/responder. Starts investigating and creates initial update/alert. At most one active incident per service. A public incident is still hidden if its service/project is private.

post.summary: Add incident update or advance lifecycle
post.description: Owner/responder. Use current version. May remain in current state or advance investigating→identified→monitoring→resolved one step. Resolved incidents cannot be updated. Update visibility does not automatically change incident-level visibility.
Owner/responder. Idempotently records actor/time. Independent of delivery success; send an empty JSON object.
Owner/responder. simulateFailure produces a durable failed attempt. Already delivered alerts are not delivered again. No real email is sent.

Owner only. Failed attempt does not change plan. Reuse the same key with simulateFailure=false to retry. Succeeded-key replay returns recorded payment; activation and audit commit once. Only advanced plan exists. No money is charged.

get.description: Public-enabled unarchived project only. Services include only public unarchived entries. Aggregate status is based on all visible services, not just this page. No raw URLs/configuration/private notes/members.
Service must currently be public and unarchived. Excludes internal reasons, actors, raw results, and URLs.
Includes public incidents only for services that are currently public. State identifies active or resolved.
Checks project, service, incident, and update visibility. No private update text or actor identifiers.

post.description: Only unique selected public service IDs from this project. Returns generic accepted response for existing email. New subscription token is stored hashed, with simulator inbox delivery. Non-production responses may include simulator token; production public response never does. No real email sent.
Consumes a valid unexpired token once and rechecks selected-service visibility. Reused token fails safely; does not prove real mailbox ownership.

get.summary: Inspect worker health and operational failures
get.description: Platform administrator only. Worker healthy is true only while running with a heartbeat less than three minutes old.
Project owner only. Contains unexpired demonstration tokens; never sent to real email. This simulation cannot prove mailbox ownership.

get.summary: Read the public HTML status page

200.description: Escaped public HTML containing up to 100 visible services and 20 recent published incidents.

bearerAuth.description: Send Authorization: Bearer <token>. Token is returned by register/login and normally expires after 24 hours; logout revokes it.

400.description: Malformed request, invalid identifier/token, or invalid public service selection.

401.description: Missing, invalid, or expired bearer session.

403.description: Current project/platform role does not allow this action.

404.description: Resource absent, archived, private, or inaccessible to this caller.

409.description: Duplicate/conflicting operation, stale version, invalid transition, or unavailable simulator.

422.description: Input fails validation, safe endpoint/configuration policy, or plan limits.

500.description: Unexpected server failure; response is sanitized.

503.description: Database or simulated delivery capability unavailable.

details.description: Optional safe validation details; no submitted secrets.

email.description: Trimmed and lowercased for identity comparison.

token.description: Opaque bearer token; returned once. Keep secret.
